# Everview

> A four-bedroom luxury villa in Camps Bay, Cape Town, sleeping 8, with panoramic Atlantic and Table Mountain views, a heated pool, and 100% solar/battery backup power.

Everview sits on Cramond Road, at the quiet, closed end of a cul-de-sac above Camps Bay's beach, with Table Mountain standing behind the house. Three levels connected by a lift, with the front patio looking out over the whole curve of Camps Bay beach and the Twelve Apostles. 4 bedrooms, 4 en-suite bathrooms and 2 guest toilets, sleeps 8, heated pool, parking for 6. A 40-panel solar array and 26kWh battery bank keep the house running through load-shedding, and water comes from a private, filtered borehole.

## Pages

- [Everview](https://jonathanavis96.github.io/everview-campsbay-villa/): The full site — the house level by level, the four bedrooms, power and water, Camps Bay and getting around, arrival and house rules, and rates.

## Details

- House: Living level (kitchen, indoor dining, formal living room, outside lounge, sunbeds, wine cellar & TV room, terrace), bedroom level (three bedrooms, pool room, study), garden level (heated pool, garden). The house is entered at street level off a driveway with room for six cars, with further parking in the cul-de-sac.
- Bedrooms: Master Suite, Ocean King, Garden King and Ground Floor King, each with an en-suite bathroom; 4 en-suite bathrooms and 2 guest toilets in total.
- Power and water: 40-panel solar array, 26kWh battery storage, and a private borehole with multi-stage filtration.
- Location: 14 Cramond Road, Camps Bay, Cape Town — a 5–8 minute walk to Camps Bay Beach, 10–15 minutes' drive to the Table Mountain cable car, 15–30 minutes to the V&A Waterfront, and 25–30 minutes to Cape Town International Airport.
- Rates: from R25,000 per night out of season to R45,000 per night in season, ZAR primary; final quote on enquiry.
- House rules: no pets, no smoking anywhere on the property, no parties or events without prior arrangement, monitored 24/7 by ADT Security with armed response.
